none: PAS LEIC-F4014B: Roman Republican silver denarius
contea di ritrovamento: Rutland (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn silver Roman Republican Denarius with central circular piercing, probably dating to the period c.140-130 BC (Reece period 1) and perhaps issued by the moneyer L. Trebanius (c.135 BC). Obverse: Helmeted head of Roma right, behind X. Reverse: Uncertain figure riding a quadriga right, illegible legend below, (ROMA) in exergue. Diameter: 17mm; Weight: 3.25g. Probably mint of Rome. Cf.
